verdict.rationale: The evidence only hints at bulk capability. The docs list "Automate tasks with Shortcuts" as a single-line mention, and a community user describes chaining shell utilities (pbpaste | json_pp | pbcopy), but nothing shows operations applied across many items at once. missing for 10: explicit documentation of batch or multi-item operations (e.g., bulk file actions, Shortcuts looping over item sets), detail on Shortcuts' bulk-processing depth, and hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
